mechanics_findings.detail: leverage_reserve = total_abs_notional/5 is exactly the minimum equity required to keep leverage=notional/equity<=5, so reserving it is not an arbitrary buffer but the algebraic inverse of the account's own 5x ceiling. maintenance_reserve additionally reserves margin-rate*notional plus the frozen close cost. required_reserve=max(leverage_reserve, maintenance_reserve) is correct (not sum): both are independent floors on how much equity must remain, so the binding constraint is whichever is larger, not their sum. free_equity=max(0, marked_equity-required_reserve) and floor_to_micro_usdt(min(0.5*retained_base, free_equity)) rounds down, i.e. only in the safe (never-over-withdraw) direction, consistent with money_precision=micro_usdt_int64 and the no-negative-cash hard gate.

'maintenance_margin_unknown_with_open_position': 'actual_withdrawal=0' fails closed exactly as required: an unknown maintenance-margin rate cannot be assumed zero (which would overstate free_equity and risk a post-withdrawal margin breach), so withdrawal is blocked entirely rather than estimated. This is consistent with g1/g2's pre-existing 'unknown_cost_decision_action=NO_TRADE' pattern applied to the withdrawal path specifically.

The override list names exactly four g2 fields (liquidity_void_stress.any_solvency_or_liquidation_breach; extreme_scenario_sizing.position_size_rule's synthetic component; extreme_scenario_sizing.stress_failure_action; batch_account_allocator.batch_if_stress_insolvent's synthetic all-correlation component). It does not touch g2's cost_coverage_gate (unknown_cost_decision_action=NO_TRADE, >=95% known-cost coverage, >=80% direct-coverage certification tier) or g1's core state/action/reward definitions, and g5's own hard_gates_preserved list is a strict, unweakened superset of what g1/g2/g4 already required for real (non-synthetic) history. The override is scoped to disclosure-not-veto for hypothetical scenario replay only; actual chronological historical liquidation/solvency breaches remain fully charged per g3/g4's ruin_rule.

All six items the task asked this reviewer to specifically confirm are present verbatim in the JSON array: actual chronological historical equity and liquidation; account gross leverage<=5; known execution cost or frozen proxy; maintenance margin at actual historical timestamps; no negative cash; PIT and time isolation. Each is independently corroborated by an unmodified upstream field: leverage<=5 by g1.action_space.max_account_leverage=5 and g3.leverage_and_execution.account_gross_leverage_hard_ceiling=5.0; known-cost-or-NO_TRADE by g2.cost_coverage_gate.unknown_cost_decision_action=NO_TRADE (not in the override list); PIT/time isolation by g1.event_identity/global_time_partitions (untouched by any overlay).

same_neutral_runner_required=true with 14 named shared fields (state_rows, decision_timestamps, partitions, reward_evaluator_hash, cost_evidence, delay, funding, min_lot, maintenance_margin, account_allocator, withdrawal_rule, no_topup_rule, ruin_rule, execution_order) and only_allowed_difference='action_policy' is a sufficient condition for apples-to-apples comparison: every input that could bias a comparison in favor of a candidate over ALWAYS_FLAT (or vice versa) is pinned identical, leaving only the decision logic itself as a free variable. baseline_output_manifest_and_hash_required=true additionally makes this falsifiable rather than a bare promise. hard=ALWAYS_FLAT / comparative_only={FIXED_LONG,FIXED_SHORT,BUY_HOLD,RANDOM_SEED42,BTC_BETA_MATCHED} is the identical 6-item partition already declared in g1.baselines and g4.baseline_policy, with no addition, removal, or reclassification across generations.

mechanics_findings.topic: Capital withdrawal rules / 5x / no negative cash across g3->g4->g5
mechanics_findings.detail: g3 introduces the 1.5B trigger / 0.5B tranche / no-topup / ruin-zeroes-equity rule; g4 pins its evaluation to bar-close DecisionTime (post-MTM, pre-new-risk) and adds the rollback-to-safe-amount-or-zero post-withdrawal check; g5 replaces g4's textual free_equity formula with the closed-form max(leverage_reserve, maintenance_reserve) reserve and adds micro-USDT determinism plus the explicit unknown-MMR=0 rule. Each generation is a strict refinement of the previous one's stated intent (never a reversal): the 1.5x/0.5x numbers, the no-automatic-topup rule, and the ruin-zeroes-but-prior-withdrawals-survive rule are byte-unchanged from g3 through g5. 5x remains the leverage ceiling in every generation (g1 action_space, g2 extreme_scenario_sizing, g3 leverage_and_execution, g4 safety block, g5 hard_gates_preserved and the reserve formula's own denominator). No negative cash is asserted as a hard, non-overridable gate starting g2 (any_solvency_or_liquidation_breach=FAIL) and reaffirmed unweakened in g5.hard_gates_preserved even though g5 explicitly relaxes the *synthetic-scenario* veto power over baseline sizing.

findings.title: Concurrently-running, out-of-scope preflight tool executed mid-review and failed closed exactly as designed, without building any dataset or touching labels
findings.detail: During this review, `cmd/data-driven-v3-dataset/main.go` and `internal/datadrivenv3/{preflight.go,preflight_test.go}` appeared in the working tree as untracked files not present in git HEAD and not authored by this reviewer, and were then actually executed (by a process other than this reviewer) before this receipt was finalized, producing `dataset_data_fitness.json`, `dataset_data_fitness.md`, `dataset_data_fitness_measurement_receipt.json`, and `dataset_decision_journal.txt` under this same directory. Read-only inspection of the outputs shows: `status="DATA_BLIND_COST"` (not `PASS`), `highest_blocker="discovery/1h/delay0 known cost coverage 0.8750 < 0.95"` (i.e. it independently measured real known-cost coverage against exactly the 0.95 threshold this reviewer verified in g2.cost_coverage_gate.formal_profile_minimum_known_cost_coverage in M6/F4, and the profile does not yet clear it), and `labels_unblinded: false`. The decision journal states verbatim 'No dataset shards or reward labels are generated unless this report is PASS' and 'Outcome fields, route results, PnL, winners, and reward labels were not read'. Because status != PASS, `main.go`'s own control flow (read in M6) never reaches dataset/state construction. `internal/datadrivenv3.ProtocolChain` also hardcodes the identical five protocol/overlay hashes this reviewer independently recomputed in M1, corroborating rather than contradicting this receipt's hash findings.
findings.resolution: Not blocking. This is additional real-world corroboration, observed incidentally, that the system remains correctly NO_GO/DATA_BLIND under g5's own cost-coverage gate: no dataset was built, no label was unblinded, and the preflight failed closed rather than being loosened to force a PASS. This receipt still does not review or approve the preflight code's correctness (its schema_version is lingxi.data-driven-router-v3.measurement-receipt.v1; its cost-coverage measurement methodology is outside the reviewed g5 protocol text); governance should commission a separate receipt for that code and its DATA_BLIND_COST classification before relying on it for anything beyond the reassurance recorded here.
